dedeene_2024_limited_mlr.paper_feature_note: Exact flow-cytometry measurements and units required; proxy dipstick/microscopy values are not interchangeable.

farashi_2025_voting_ensemble.paper_feature_note: 18 variables selected/reported on Taylor et al.'s ED cohort; feature selection and tuning must be training-fold confined for reproduction.
farashi_2025_voting_ensemble.compatibility_note: Taylor is the source cohort used in the paper, so a re-analysis is not independent validation; ARMD is a different culture cohort and lacks a verified mapping.

lin_2026_seven_feature_rf.paper_feature_note: Seven pediatric-source clinical/UA features. Applying to adult data is out-of-domain adaptation, not direct reproduction.
lin_2026_seven_feature_rf.compatibility_note: Exact analyte availability/units and assay mappings are unverified for both candidate files.
